fields.aka: Madhvācārya, Pūrṇaprajña Tīrtha, Ānanda Tīrtha, Vāsudeva (childhood name), Madhva
fields.appearance: Āśvina śukla daśamī (Vijayā-daśamī) (Gauḍīya calendar); 1238 (Madhva-vijaya; Narahari Tīrtha's inscriptions; the record also has 1040 Śaka)
fields.disappearance: Māgha śukla navamī (Gauḍīya calendar); 1317, at seventy-nine
fields.place: Born at Pājaka-kṣetra near Uḍupī (South Kanara); Badarikāśrama; Uḍupī (Kṛṣṇa and the eight maṭhas)
fields.guru: Acyutaprekṣa Tīrtha (sannyāsa); Śrī Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana Vyāsadeva (instruction at Badarikāśrama)
fields.works: Brahma-sūtra-bhāṣya; Anu-bhāṣya; Anuvyākhyāna; Gītā-bhāṣya; Gītā-tātparya-nirṇaya; Upaniṣad-bhāṣyas; Ṛg-bhāṣya; Bhāgavata-tātparya; Mahābhārata-tātparya-nirṇaya; Dvādaśa-stotra; Kṛṣṇāmṛta-mahārṇava; Pramāṇa-lakṣaṇa; Tattva-viveka (thirty-seven works)
fields.notes:
Founder of Tattvavāda (Dvaita). Parents: Madhyageha Bhaṭṭa and Vedavatī; childhood name Vāsudeva; a Śivaḷḷi brāhmaṇa. Took sannyāsa from Acyutaprekṣa (named Pūrṇaprajña), later called Ānanda Tīrtha; met Vyāsadeva at Badarikāśrama; installed Kṛṣṇa (Bāla-kṛṣṇa) at Uḍupī and founded the eight maṭhas (Palimār, Admār, Kṛṣṇāpur, Puttige, Śirur, Sode, Kāṇiyūr, Pejāvar); the Uttarādi maṭha's first head was Padmanābha Tīrtha (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Vāyu, who came as Hanumān and Bhīma.

Paramparā (Gauḍīya Sampradāya chart): the Gauḍīya line comes from him through Jayatīrtha, Vyāsatīrtha and Lakṣmīpati to Mādhavendra Purī — succession according to Baladeva; the link is disputed by historians.

fields.name: Śrī Rāmānujācārya
fields.aka: Rāmānujācārya, Rāmānuja, Lakṣmaṇa (birth name), Yatirāja, Ilaya Perumāḷ
fields.appearance: Caitra śukla pañcamī, 938 Śaka (1017), at Śrīperumbudūr (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; Gauḍīya calendar)
fields.place: Śrīperumbudūr (Tamil Nadu); Kāñcī; Śrī Raṅgam; Melukoṭe (Karnataka)
fields.guru: Mahāpūrṇa (Periya Nambi) (pañca-saṁskāra); Yāmunācārya (whose wishes he fulfilled); studied with Yādavaprakāśa
fields.disciples: Kūreśa, Govinda (Embār), Dāśarathi and many others; King Viṣṇuvardhana
fields.works: Śrī-bhāṣya; Vedārtha-saṅgraha; Vedānta-sāra; Vedānta-dīpa; Gītā-bhāṣya; Gadya-traya
fields.notes:
Ācārya of the Śrī-sampradāya and teacher of Viśiṣṭādvaita, against Śaṅkara's Advaita (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Son of Āsuri Keśava and Kāntimatī. Studied with Yādavaprakāśa at Kāñcī; fulfilled Yāmunācārya's three wishes; pañca-saṁskāra from Mahāpūrṇa; sannyāsa at Kāñcī; ācārya of Śrī Raṅgam; proclaimed Goṣṭhīpūrṇa's mantra to all; lived at Melukoṭe during the Coḷa persecution. Rāmānanda Svāmī came twenty-one generations after him.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Lakṣmaṇa / Ananta Śeṣa.

In the tree in «Other Vaiṣṇava lines» (his gurus have no records).
